title: Cardiovascular system
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Integrate cardiac anatomy and embryology, the cardiac cycle, electrophysiology and the ECG, arrhythmias, hypertension, atherosclerosis, ischemic heart disease, heart failure, valvular, myocardial, pericardial and congenital disease, vascular disease and cardiovascular drugs.

blocks.deliverable: Draw a pressure–volume loop and explain preload and afterload.
Interpret rate, rhythm, axis and intervals on supplied ECG descriptions.
Choose a first-line antihypertensive for different patients.
Week 7 midterm; manage a case of acute coronary syndrome.
Match murmurs to their valve lesions and maneuvers.
Compare the major drug classes for heart failure.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Cardiology casebook: interpret five supplied ECG descriptions and sets of hemodynamic data, and explain each diagnosis and its first-line treatment.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
